name: Taihan Fiber Optics Co., Ltd
summary: Taihan Fiber Optics Co., Ltd researches, develops, and produces optical materials in South Korea and internationally. The company offers optical fibers, aerials, duct / direct buried solutions, air blown solutions, micro module cables, high density, indoor, round, flat, and pre-connected, specialty fibers, medical fibers, OPGW, and power cables. It also provides FTTH network building solutions, photoelectric composite hybrid cable solutions, fiber-optic cable solutions, optical communication infrastructure solutions, smart campus solutions, education and training, and data management and maintenance services.
